title: Seamist #5
meta_description: Perched on a grassy ledge overlooking the Gulf of Mexico below, Seamist #5 is a pristine beachfront condominium with an ideal, central location, a private bedroom, and another bunk bed sleeping space that the kids will love.
description_expanded: DescriptionNestled on a scenic grassy ledge with stunning views of the Gulf of Mexico, Seamist #5 is a beachfront condominium perfect for your next vacation. This charming unit features one private bedroom and a bunk bed space that kids will adore, offering a cozy yet affordable retreat.The Seamist building offers parking in the front, with stairs leading to door number 5. Step inside to a spacious, open-plan living area that boasts breathtaking turquoise ocean views. Whether you prefer to relax indoors with your favorite show on the large HDTV or unwind on the private, covered patio with the soothing sounds of the waves, Seamist #5 has it all.The bright and airy kitchen is open to the living area and equipped with everything you need, including white cabinets, a coffee maker, blender, and all necessary dishware and glassware. Enjoy casual dining in this well-appointed space.The private bedroom features a luxurious king-size bed facing a mounted HDTV, providing a perfect sanctuary for relaxation. The hallway includes a custom-built bunk bed with twin-size beds and individual reading lamps, ideal for additional guests.The full bathroom is equipped with a tub/shower combo, white tile, and a marble-topped vanity sink. You’ll also find a convenient stacked washer and dryer in this private space.Located right on one of the world’s most beautiful beaches, Seamist #5 is the ideal home base for exploring Seacrest Beach. Easy beach access and proximity to local restaurants and shops ensure a delightful stay.HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Professionally decorated • Close to beach access • Stunning Gulf and beach views • Complete Clean Bedding ProgramMAIN FLOOR: (Sleeps 4) • PRIMARY BEDROOM: King-size bed (Sleeps 2) • GUEST SLEEPING SPACE: Twin-size bunk beds (Sleeps 2) • LIVING ROOM • GOURMET KITCHEN • FULL BATHROOM • LAUNDRY NOOK • OUTDOOR PATIOSeacrest Area Highlights: • Situated between Alys Beach/Rosemary Beach and Seagrove Beach • 20-minute bike ride to Seaside Beach • 10-minute bike ride to Rosemary Beach • Shopping and dining at Villages of South Walton • Weekly live music performances during peak seasons at Villages of South Walton and Alys Beach
